notes.title: Hotfix v1.02 : Bug in Chapter 2, gallery and patchnote link
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Another hotfix to fix some issues found by the players:
- In chapter 2, there was a bug on the gameplay part in the bar screen.
- Patchnote button on the main menu was linked to the wrong game ID.
- The gallery was displayed some unnecessary pictures (backgrounds or bartender...).
- Fixed a bug on save for the last chapter played.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.01 : Font issue
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
A very quick hotfix for the font of the text in the game, thanks to the help of Semeicardia who spotted that it was the wrong font we used!
